confidence_note: Confidence is the maximum predict_proba score. It is not a calibrated probability; consumers must treat scores below the threshold as abstain. The default 0.20 threshold is an operational routing choice for eight classes, not a measure of certainty.

metadata.provenance: Phase 1 hand-written synthetic starter examples plus Phase 1.1 focused synthetic examples for ambiguous Electrical and Network / IT complaints. These are not real campus complaints.

phase1_1_additions.focus: Ambiguous electrical versus internet, network, and IT device failures.

metadata.synthetic_marking: Every row has a source column. Both source values are synthetic; no real campus complaint text is present.
metadata.label_source: Synthetic category labels aligned with the eight categories in the existing Flutter report form.
metadata.pii_review: No names, student IDs, contact details, credentials, addresses, or other personal information are present.
metadata.intended_use: Focused synthetic error analysis and baseline regression testing only.
metadata.collection_method: Hand-written from common campus facility, network, and IT support scenarios; no campus records or test examples were copied.
metadata.evaluation_protocol: Train on all non-holdout v2 rows and evaluate on the untouched 48-row Phase 1 baseline holdout. Near-duplicate groups are checked for holdout leakage.
metadata.notes: Do not describe this dataset or its metrics as production evidence. The additions deliberately over-sample the two confused categories and make the dataset intentionally non-uniform.

split.leakage_guard: Exact duplicates are rejected; near-identical rows are grouped by TF-IDF cosine similarity before the split.
split.holdout_description: Untouched 48-row Phase 1 baseline test set reconstructed with fraction=0.25, random_state=42. All Phase 1.1 additions are in training.

limitations: This artifact is trained on a small, hand-written synthetic dataset.
The examples are not real campus complaints and the labels are not human-verified.
Phase 1.1 additions, where present, were guided by error review; the fixed holdout is a targeted synthetic regression benchmark, not a clean generalization test.
Metrics describe this synthetic holdout split only and are not production evidence.
The model accepts only the description text and does not use identity or role data.
Confidence scores are uncalibrated and must not be shown as certainty.
Low-confidence results require manual review or retention of the existing category.
No priority prediction, duplicate detection, chatbot, or automatic report mutation is included.
